name: mysoftware
description: Private toolkit for running our Shopify store: plan, test, review and remember, plus Shopify theme/app/Functions/Admin API know-how and guardrails against accidental live-store changes.

hooks_enabled.title: Enable MySoftware hooks
hooks_enabled.description: Run the safety and session-memory hooks. Turn off to keep only agents, commands and skills.

hook_profile.title: Hook profile
hook_profile.description: minimal (safety hooks only), standard (plus session memory) or strict (plus checks after every edit). Anything else means standard.
